name: Otchi Kocchi
source: At the end of his second year in college, Shirou Atazuki's life is at a dead end. Never having made a tough decision, he's just been skating by in life. Now, with his grades foundering and his girlfriend gone, due to his indecisiveness, he meekly follows a counselor's suggestion to take a part-time job in the Pharmacy Department at the attached Teaching Hospital. There, he meets his new colleagues and has a chance to change his world beyond anything he could imagine... the choice is his. There, he encounters four young women the likes of which he's never imagined. Some, haunted by their past, some, their future. One, a ticking time bomb, another, a blade over his heart. Decisions? Decisions! Think fast, and hold to those choices! Your future is in your hands...don't let it slip!
translation: 大学二年级结束时，热月士郎的人生陷入了死胡同。他从来没有做出过艰难的决定，他只是在生活中度过。如今，成绩一落千丈，女友也离去，优柔寡断的他只能乖乖听从辅导员的建议，到附属教学医院药剂科做兼职。在那里，他遇到了新同事，并有机会改变他的世界，超出他的想象……选择是他的。在那里，他遇到了四位他从未想象过的年轻女子。有些人为他们的过去所困扰，有些人则为他们的未来所困扰。一颗，一颗定时炸弹，另一颗，一把插在他心脏上的利刃。决定？决定！快速思考，并坚持这些选择！你的未来掌握在你的手中……不要让它溜走！
